Hotel General Manager

The Harbour House Hotel, Brighton

Location: Brighton, UK
Contract: Full-time, permanent
Salary: £55,000 - £65,000 per annum

The Harbour House is a 96-room independent hotel on the seafront. We are looking for a general
manager who can run a busy property with warmth and discipline.

Requirements:
- At least five years in hotel operations, two of them as a deputy or general manager
- Proven record managing a P&L and a team of 40 or more
- Strong revenue management skills
- Flexibility to work evenings and weekends

Preferred:
- Experience with Opera PMS
- A degree in hospitality management

We offer 28 days holiday, a staff meal on every shift and a share of the service charge.
